families.deviation: Model-callable V1 and V2 Conversation profiles start real supervised child Conversations. Regression chains cover interrupt/send, completed follow-up, close/resume, committed file mutation without replay, preserved quotas/history, and old-run fencing. Strict-store/fault tests exercise the manager with real children, not a production durable store. Native Codex event-wire parity remains unverified.

required_backends: owner PID and host-selected resource adapters
families.deviation: Real Linux LocalCommand processes and same-group descendants are checked through Conversation completion, cancellation during launch/polling, returned-session cancellation, deadlines, provider/store failure, lost acknowledgement and owner death. Registry callback fault tests retain failed/uncertain evidence. Direct Codex.call command-session tests reject stale trusted incarnations. Registries remain process-local; escaped sessions and restart durability are not covered.

Direct Codex.call -> Command -> real Linux LocalCommand tests separate response truncation from host hard limits and check repeated stdin cursors and completion markers. Lifecycle tests additionally use admitted Conversation dispatch. Output token budgeting is a four-bytes-per-token estimate, PTY remains rejected, and process-group proof is Linux-only.
The pinned model schema hides host CAS state; the backend reads and advances the scoped revision. Native Codex event wire was not compared.

required_backends: scoped ephemeral reference runtime or host adapter
families.deviation: All 27 concrete tools dispatch through Conversation with scoped state and owner cleanup. Reference state is ephemeral; complete pinned output schemas and durable restart recovery remain unverified.

required_backends: authorized workspace and image artifact path
families.deviation: Direct ApplyPatch real-filesystem tests cover ordered hunks, anchors, EOF constraints, rename edits/directories, malformed bodies, confinement and partial/uncertain mutations. Existing profile and collaboration chains also execute apply_patch through Conversation. Whole-patch atomicity and native output/event parity are not claimed.
Pinned names and schemas are exposed. Early interruption on new turn input is not proven equivalent to the pinned implementation.

required_backends: host interaction, permission, readiness, and token providers as selected
families.deviation: Replies and grants are host-resolved and context replacement preserves runtime resources. Exact token accounting depends on a host provider and native UI/event parity is unverified.
Bounded raw strings survive catalog, execution, and provider continuation. Native streaming custom-input delta parity remains unverified.

required_backends: host MCP/resource adapter and admitted dynamic candidates
families.deviation: A real local TCP JSON-RPC resource call and post-batch publication fencing are covered. Production MCP transports, credentials, pagination, and full Codex wire parity remain unverified.
Search is bounded and owner-scoped, and discovered tools become callable only on the next provider turn. Native ranking/loading semantics remain unverified.

required_backends: Deno, ResourceRegistry, and admitted nested dispatcher
families.deviation: Real Deno Conversation tests exercise exec -> yield -> later provider turn -> wait -> nested dispatch after the original effect Task exits, plus lifecycle cancellation. A real CPU-bound Deno process is checked for OS termination after timeout. Framing tests inject deterministic raw-byte splits into the packaged worker and separately exercise real CodeMode.execute with large source/results. Wait remains a generator continuation, not pinned time-sliced running-cell behavior; native wire parity remains unverified.

required_backends: host-configured web/image adapters, allowlists, and credentials
families.deviation: Pinned web::run and image_gen::imagegen plus explicit Backplane compatibility tools execute through Conversation with injected adapters. No production service conformance was run.

required_backends: provider capability negotiation and observation adapter
families.deviation: Source-referenced web_search declarations are projected outside ToolRegistry and provider events are normalized. Tests use an injected adapter; no live provider was available.
Requests and receipts are host-mediated; accepted/completed receipts do not silently install a tool or grant authority. No production installer was configured.
The pinned source marks this experimental registration test-only. It remains inventoried and intentionally unavailable in production profiles.

regression_review.evidence_note: Test files distinguish direct helper/backend paths from admitted Conversation and real-effect paths. No production durability, native-wire, or live-service parity claim follows from these repairs.

non_claims: Exact-source inventory is not behavioral parity.
No production provider or service conformance was run.
No durable extension restart recovery was run.
Native Codex event, worker, PTY, and complete output-schema parity remain incomplete.
